<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-2011-26-15" status="unreviewed"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> na re dam bca' la bsal pa 'jug mi srid pa yin zhes zer | 
               
               de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:">gzhan dag</rs> na re byas pas sgra rtag pa skrab pa na mi rtag par
               <lb n="66a3"/>ma nges pa'i tshe na yang dam bca' la bsal par 'gyur 'dod na 'gal ba la phyog chos med par thal des na <<note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">rtsang</rs></note>> dam bca' la dngos su ma zhugs pa 1 yin zer|
               'di dag sgrub bya'i rnam dbye ma rtogs par zad desgrub bya don skyon med la byed dam skyon yon brtsi ba'i sgrub bya 'am dam bca' skyon Na la byed dang po ltar na bsal ba 'jug mi srid pa dgos pas bsa pa dngos su ma zhugs pa
               <lb n="66a4"/>yin pa nyams 2 pa ltar na brtsod pa'i gnas skabs de na dam bca' la bsal pa dngos su bang thugs pas chog pa'i phyir bsal pa 'jug mi srid pa dgos pa nyam ng | des na rtags kyi nus yul myi sgrub bya 'am don skyan med kyi ma bsal ba ni bsal pa 'jug mi srid pa 1 yin | skyon yon brtsi ba'i sgrub bya 'i dam bca' la ma bsal ba ni bsalpa pa dngos su ma zhugs pa
               <lb n="66a5"/>tsam 1 yin | des na 'gal ba'i dam bca' 'a bsal ba 'jug srid pa'i phyir de la bsMs kyi phyogs chos med par thal zer na 'dod la phyogs chos tsam med par thal zer na ma nges so |</seg></TEI>
